# Sample

A made-up Lahe style for the test suite. It exists so the tests can install,
serve and render a style without any paid style entering this public repo.

- A cream page (`#fbf3e4`), dark brown ink (`#2b1d0e`), a green accent (`#1f6b3a`).
- One face, "Sample Face", which is a renamed copy of the vendored JetBrains
  Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `LICENSE`).

`lahe style add` copies this file for the reader. The page server never serves it.
